sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `mvv2e * ftm2v == 1`
sanitizers.alarm: `|mvv2e*ftm2v - 1| > 1e-7` (two independently stored <=9-digit literals)
sanitizers.rationale: Newton's second law uses both conversions; each unit system must keep them inverse

sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `boltz` equals CODATA k_B expressed in the style's energy per kelvin
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 1e-5 (about 10x the CODATA 2006->2018 spread of at most 1.2e-6, and above the 5e-6 rounding of the shortest stored literal)
sanitizers.rationale: every temperature, degree-of-freedom and thermostat computation scales with it

sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `hplanck` equals CODATA h in the style's energy*time
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 1e-5 (about 10x the CODATA 2006->2018 spread of at most 1.2e-6, and above the 5e-6 rounding of the shortest stored literal)
sanitizers.rationale: used by spin dynamics and exposed to the library API

sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `qqr2e` equals e^2/(4 pi eps0) in the style's energy*length/charge^2 (charge unit of that style)
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 1e-5 (about 10x the CODATA 2006->2018 spread of at most 1.2e-6, and above the 5e-6 rounding of the shortest stored literal)
sanitizers.rationale: scales every Coulomb pair and k-space energy and force

sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `nktv2p` equals (energy / length^3) of the style expressed in its pressure unit
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 1e-5 (about 10x the CODATA 2006->2018 spread of at most 1.2e-6, and above the 5e-6 rounding of the shortest stored literal)
sanitizers.rationale: scales every pressure and virial output

sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `mvv2e` equals mass*(length/time)^2 of the style expressed in its energy unit
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 1e-5 (about 10x the CODATA 2006->2018 spread of at most 1.2e-6, and above the 5e-6 rounding of the shortest stored literal)
sanitizers.rationale: scales every kinetic energy and temperature

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: length, time and charge scale factors
sanitizers.precondition: any `units` style except `lj` (real, metal, si, cgs, electron, micro, nano)
sanitizers.invariant: `angstrom`, `femtosecond`, `qelectron` equal the SI length, time and elementary-charge scale of the style
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 1e-5 (about 10x the CODATA 2006->2018 spread of at most 1.2e-6, and above the 5e-6 rounding of the shortest stored literal)
sanitizers.rationale: used by unit-aware commands and external interfaces

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net force of one force stage
sanitizers.precondition: any pair style with `newton_pair on` (no verdict with newton off: rounding scale not observable); summation over nlocal+nghost
sanitizers.invariant: the pair stage adds forces whose vector sum is zero (translation invariance of the pair energy)
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|terms| (N rounded terms, order-independent bound; eps = 2.2e-16) with sum|f| before+after
sanitizers.rationale: a net force on an isolated set of atoms means momentum is created from nothing

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net force of one force stage
sanitizers.precondition: bond style set, `newton_bond on`
sanitizers.invariant: the bond stage adds forces summing to zero
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|terms| (N rounded terms, order-independent bound; eps = 2.2e-16)
sanitizers.rationale: translation invariance of the bond energy

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net force of one force stage
sanitizers.precondition: angle style set, `newton_bond on`
sanitizers.invariant: the angle stage adds forces summing to zero
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|terms| (N rounded terms, order-independent bound; eps = 2.2e-16)
sanitizers.rationale: translation invariance of the angle energy

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net force of one force stage
sanitizers.precondition: dihedral style set, `newton_bond on`
sanitizers.invariant: the dihedral stage adds forces summing to zero
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|terms| (N rounded terms, order-independent bound; eps = 2.2e-16)
sanitizers.rationale: translation invariance of the dihedral energy

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net force of one force stage
sanitizers.precondition: improper style set, `newton_bond on`
sanitizers.invariant: the improper stage adds forces summing to zero
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|terms| (N rounded terms, order-independent bound; eps = 2.2e-16)
sanitizers.rationale: translation invariance of the improper energy

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net torque of the pair stage
sanitizers.precondition: non-periodic in all dimensions, point particles (no torque/angmom per atom)
sanitizers.invariant: `sum over atoms of x cross delta f` is zero (rotation invariance of the pair energy)
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(x cross delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|x||f|
sanitizers.rationale: a net torque on an isolated system creates angular momentum

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: net torque of one bonded stage
sanitizers.precondition: non-periodic in all dimensions, point particles
sanitizers.invariant: the bonded stage adds forces with zero net torque
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(x cross delta f)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|x||f|
sanitizers.rationale: rotation invariance of the bonded energies

sanitizers.precondition: `velocity create` (momentum zeroing on, no `sum`, no bias) or `velocity zero linear` without rigid fix
sanitizers.invariant: `sum(m v)` over the group is zero
sanitizers.alarm: `|sum(m v)| > tol`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|terms| (N rounded terms, order-independent bound; eps = 2.2e-16), scale sum m|v| (including before zeroing)
sanitizers.rationale: center-of-mass drift contaminates pressure and diffusion

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: total angular momentum about the center of mass
sanitizers.precondition: 3d, rotation zeroing on (or `zero angular`), no `sum`, no bias, group inertia tensor invertible (cond <= 1e6)
sanitizers.invariant: `sum m (r - r_cm) cross v` is zero, with unwrapped coordinates
sanitizers.alarm: `|L| > tol*cond(I)`; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum m|r||v|
sanitizers.rationale: spurious rigid rotation of a finite cluster

sanitizers.precondition: any periodic box (lamda coordinates for triclinic); image counts of the atom below the +-512 image-flag limit
sanitizers.invariant: wrapping atoms into the box leaves `x + image*box` unchanged
sanitizers.observation_point: snapshot at entry and exit of `pbc()`
sanitizers.alarm: |change| > 64*eps*(N=1+10)*(|unwrapped|+period) in any component
sanitizers.rationale: MSD, diffusion and molecule integrity rely on image flags

sanitizers.precondition: any periodic box; image count below the +-512 image-flag limit
sanitizers.invariant: remapping one atom leaves `x + image*box` unchanged
sanitizers.alarm: |change| > 64*eps*11*(|unwrapped|+period)
sanitizers.rationale: atoms created, read or displaced pass through remap

sanitizers.precondition: separation within a few box lengths; periodic dimensions
sanitizers.invariant: output differs from input by an integer combination of periodic box vectors (none along non-periodic dimensions); for orthogonal boxes it is never longer
sanitizers.alarm: non-integer lattice coefficient > 64*eps*(|d|/L_min+1); or orthogonal box with |out|^2 > |in|^2*(1+64*eps)
sanitizers.rationale: pair separation drives every interaction; triclinic reduction is sequential, so only the lattice property is required there

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: box edge lengths, angles and volume
sanitizers.precondition: right-handed general triclinic edge vectors A, B, C
sanitizers.invariant: the rotation to restricted triclinic preserves all pairwise dot products of the edge vectors and the volume
sanitizers.alarm: dot-product mismatch > 64*eps*11*(sum|edge|)^2, or volume mismatch > 64*eps*11*(sum|edge|)^3
sanitizers.rationale: the restricted box must be a rigid rotation of the one the user defined

sanitizers.precondition: `pair_modify mix geometric|arithmetic|sixthpower`, positive input distances
sanitizers.invariant: the combined distance lies between the two input distances (it is a mean)
sanitizers.alarm: result outside [min, max] by more than 64*eps*max
sanitizers.rationale: a combining rule that leaves its inputs' range is not a mean

sanitizers.precondition: owner on the same process, atom tags enabled
sanitizers.invariant: ghost position = owner position + integer combination of periodic box vectors; no shift along non-periodic dimensions
sanitizers.observation_point: end of `borders()` (lamda coordinates when triclinic) and end of `forward_comm()`
sanitizers.alarm: box coefficient farther than 64*eps*(xmax/L+11) from an integer
sanitizers.rationale: a wrongly placed image gives wrong forces silently

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: ghost atom type, charge, mass, radius
sanitizers.precondition: owner on the same process, atom tags enabled
sanitizers.invariant: ghost type, q, rmass and radius equal the owner's
sanitizers.alarm: any difference (values are copied verbatim)
sanitizers.rationale: forces on ghost images use these properties

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: pair completeness of a neighbor list
sanitizers.precondition: perpetual atom-pair list (no skip/cut/ghost/size/history/bond/rRESPA/copy/trim modifiers), atomic system, no exclusions or group restriction, nlocal*nall <= 2e7; half lists need newton on
sanitizers.invariant: every atom pair with r^2 < cutneighsq*(1-1e-12) is in the list (full list: per atom; half list: total count >= half the brute-force count)
sanitizers.observation_point: after the perpetual lists are built
sanitizers.alarm: a brute-force pair is absent / half-list entry count below the brute-force lower bound
sanitizers.rationale: a missed interaction silently drops energy and force

sanitizers.precondition: same plain-list class as NBR-001 (atomic or molecular)
sanitizers.invariant: no self pair, no neighbor repeated in a row, and for half lists with newton on no local-local pair stored from both sides
sanitizers.observation_point: after the perpetual lists are built
sanitizers.alarm: a repeated or self entry
sanitizers.rationale: a repeated pair is counted twice in energy and force

sanitizers.precondition: single process, all bond types > 0
sanitizers.invariant: each atom's stored 1-2 set equals its bond partners in the bond graph
sanitizers.alarm: set mismatch against an independent bond-graph scan
sanitizers.rationale: special_bonds scaling is applied from these lists

sanitizers.precondition: as SPEC-001; 1-3 computed by the chosen `special_bonds`; no angle trimming
sanitizers.invariant: stored 1-3 set equals atoms at bond-graph distance exactly 2
sanitizers.alarm: set mismatch against shortest-path BFS
sanitizers.rationale: scaling of angle-end pair interactions

sanitizers.precondition: as SPEC-001; 1-4 computed; no angle or dihedral trimming
sanitizers.invariant: stored 1-4 set equals atoms at bond-graph distance exactly 3
sanitizers.alarm: set mismatch against shortest-path BFS
sanitizers.rationale: scaling of dihedral-end pair interactions (e.g. CHARMM/AMBER 1-4)

sanitizers.precondition: pair virial tallied pair by pair (not the f.r shortcut), `newton_pair on`
sanitizers.invariant: tallied virial equals sum over all atoms (ghosts included) of x (outer) delta f
sanitizers.alarm: any of 6 components off by > tol; tol = 64*eps*(N+10)*sum|x||f|
sanitizers.rationale: two independent routes to the stress that pressure reports

sanitizers.precondition: compute group holds every atom, global energy tallied this step, no k-space, no per-atom fix energy
sanitizers.invariant: sum of per-atom energies equals the tallied pair + bonded energy
sanitizers.alarm: mismatch > 64*eps*(N+10)*(sum|e_i|+|E|)
sanitizers.rationale: a per-atom energy must conserve the total

sanitizers.precondition: `min_style cg` with backtrack or quadratic line search (not forcezero), no `fix box/relax`
sanitizers.invariant: an accepted line-search step does not raise the energy
sanitizers.alarm: E_new > E_old + 64*eps*(N+10)*(|E_new|+|E_old|)
sanitizers.rationale: sufficient decrease is the line search's contract

sanitizers.precondition: one process; only `fix nve` on group all (internal STORE fixes allowed); atom count unchanged during the step
sanitizers.invariant: sum(m v) changes by 0.5*dt*ftm2v*(sum f at step start + sum f after force computation)
sanitizers.observation_point: start of step / before final_integrate / end of step
sanitizers.alarm: residual > 64*eps*(N+10)*(sum|p| + dtf*sum|f|)
sanitizers.rationale: momentum conservation through the integrator with per-atom masses

sanitizers.precondition: lj units, 3d, any lattice style
sanitizers.invariant: `nbasis / |det(lattice2box unit vectors)|` equals the requested reduced density
sanitizers.observation_point: right after the lattice transform is set
sanitizers.alarm: relative mismatch > 64*eps*(prod|edges|/volume + 10)
sanitizers.rationale: the density chosen by the user defines the thermodynamic state

sanitizers.precondition: `fix rigid` bodies
sanitizers.invariant: each atom's distance to its body center of mass equals the body-frame `displace` length
sanitizers.alarm: |r - |displace|| > 64*eps*11*(r+|displace|+|xcm|)
sanitizers.rationale: atomic coordinates must be a rigid rotation of the body frame

sanitizers.precondition: 3d, point particles, bodies wholly in the temperature group, atoms of a body not all coincident, body not near-collinear-ambiguous (eigenvalue ratio outside the rounding floor and 1e-4)
sanitizers.invariant: removed dof = 3N - (3 for coincident, 5 for collinear, 6 otherwise)
sanitizers.alarm: total differs from the geometric count
sanitizers.rationale: wrong dof gives a wrong temperature and thermostat
